name: council
description: Strict $council only: first visible line, if any, must be Council progress; coordinator proactively cleans stale Council agents before any spawn.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Strict $council/review/debate. Absolute first action: load the installed Council SKILL. If any visible skill-use announcement, setup plan, or status line is unavoidable, the entire first visible line must start exactly `Council progress:`; otherwise emit no pre-skill text. Never write bare lines like `Using council`, `Loading Council rules`, `Load Council rules first`, or `Checking live agents`. No `pwd`, `cd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, command chaining, web_search, browser, search, memory, repo discovery, git history, Claude assets, or shell-based agent probing before or during orchestration unless the user supplied exact files/diffs or direct read/search. Empty-query web_search is forbidden. If the SKILL must be read by shell, run only the direct SKILL read command, not `cd ... && ...`, `pwd && ...`, or any chained command. Inline text is complete unless user gives @path, exact files, a diff, or direct read/search. all/broad >6 without approval outputs exact denial with no tools/commentary. After SKILL load, every visible progress line starts `Council progress:`. The coordinator must proactively inspect native live-agent state before any reviewer spawn, close every visible stale Council child, wait for close results, re-check state, and only then choose wave size. If state is clean/root-only, attempt the full selected roster when it is 6 or fewer. Spawn failures with no receiver thread are pending-capacity retries, not launched reviewers and not final missing reviewers. Raw child notifications are private input only and must never be echoed. Do not emit JSON, `<subagent_notification>`, `/root/...`, or child payload text as user-visible content. Progress lines that claim checking/verifying/retrying/closing/waiting must be followed by the matching native tool call. `close_agent` status `running` is non-terminal until an actual wait/follow-up/close/list tool call resolves it.
defaultPrompt: For $council, first load the local SKILL. If any setup plan or skill-use announcement is unavoidable, the first visible line must start exactly `Council progress:`.
Never write bare prefaces like `Using council`, `Loading Council rules`, `Load Council rules first`, or `Checking live agents`.
When reading the SKILL, do not run cd, pwd, ls, find, rg, or chained shell commands; use only the direct installed SKILL read.
Before spawning, inspect native live-agent state, close stale Council children, and re-check state.
The coordinator must proactively remove every stale Council child it can see before any reviewer spawn.
If state is clean/root-only, attempt the full selected roster when it is 6 or fewer; no-receiver thread-limit failures remain pending for retry after launched reviewers close.
$council spawn prompts must include `Your first line must be exactly: ## <display name> review` before the assignment block.

$council never prefaces, truncates fixed rosters, accepts wrong reviewer headings, treats no-receiver capacity failures as final, skips mandatory headings, queues next-wave spawns before closes, sends malformed prompts, sends shorthand material, claims tool actions without the tool call, or leaks raw child payloads.
